description_target.target_text: Treat the modal non-zero color as the lattice divider and 0 as empty cell interior. Each other color marks one or more 2x2 lattice cells. For each marker color independently, whenever two or more markers share a coarse row, fill every 2x2 cell from the leftmost through the rightmost marker; whenever two or more share a coarse column, fill from the topmost through the bottommost marker. Apply both directions, and leave singleton or off-line markers unchanged.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let ((lc (mode g))
        (h (rows g)) (w (cols g)))
    (let ((mcolors (filter (lambda (kc) (and (not (= kc 0)) (not (= kc lc))))
                     (unique (flatmap (lambda (r) r) (grid->list g))))))
      (reduce (lambda (acc mc)
        (let ((positions (find-color g mc)))
          (let ((cpositions (map (lambda (p)
                  (list (floor (/ (+ (fst p) 1) 3)) (floor (/ (+ (snd p) 1) 3))))
                positions)))
            (let ((crow-set (unique (map fst cpositions)))
                  (ccol-set (unique (map snd cpositions))))
              (let ((acc2 (reduce (lambda (a cr)
                (let ((cols-here (map snd (filter (lambda (cp) (= (fst cp) cr)) cpositions))))
                  (if (< (length cols-here) 2) a
                    (let ((cmin (min-list cols-here)) (cmax (max-list cols-here)))
                      (reduce (lambda (a2 cc)
                        (let ((pr (* 3 cr)) (pc (* 3 cc)))
                          (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell a2 pr pc mc)
                            pr (+ pc 1) mc) (+ pr 1) pc mc) (+ pr 1) (+ pc 1) mc)))
                        a (range cmin (+ cmax 1)))))))
                acc crow-set)))
                (reduce (lambda (a cc)
                  (let ((rows-here (map fst (filter (lambda (cp) (= (snd cp) cc)) cpositions))))
                    (if (< (length rows-here) 2) a
                      (let ((rmin (min-list rows-here)) (rmax (max-list rows-here)))
                        (reduce (lambda (a2 cr)
                          (let ((pr (* 3 cr)) (pc (* 3 cc)))
                            (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell a2 pr pc mc)
                              pr (+ pc 1) mc) (+ pr 1) pc mc) (+ pr 1) (+ pc 1) mc)))
                          a (range rmin (+ rmax 1)))))))
                  acc2 ccol-set))))))
        g mcolors)))))
racket_target.target_code:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; The modal color is the one-pixel lattice divider; 0 is empty cell interior.
  (let* ((lc (mode g))
         (mcolors (filter (lambda (kc) (and (!= kc 0) (!= kc lc)))
                    (unique (flatmap (lambda (r) r) (grid->list g))))))
    (reduce (lambda (acc mc)
      ;; Collapse each 2x2 marker block to its coarse lattice coordinate.
      (let* ((positions (find-color g mc))
             (cpositions (map (lambda (p)
                 (list (floor (/ (+ (fst p) 1) 3))
                       (floor (/ (+ (snd p) 1) 3))))
               positions))
             (crow-set (unique (map fst cpositions)))
             (ccol-set (unique (map snd cpositions)))
             ;; In every coarse row, fill from the leftmost to rightmost
             ;; same-color marker; rows with fewer than two markers do nothing.
             (acc2 (reduce (lambda (a cr)
               (let* ((cols-here (map snd
                                  (filter (lambda (cp) (= (fst cp) cr)) cpositions))))
                 (if (< (length cols-here) 2) a
                   (let* ((cmin (min-list cols-here))
                          (cmax (max-list cols-here)))
                     (reduce (lambda (a2 cc)
                       (let* ((pr (* 3 cr)) (pc (* 3 cc)))
                         (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell a2 pr pc mc)
                           pr (+ pc 1) mc) (+ pr 1) pc mc) (+ pr 1) (+ pc 1) mc)))
                       a (range cmin (+ cmax 1)))))))
             acc crow-set)))
        ;; Apply the same interval rule independently down every coarse column.
        ;; Singleton or off-line markers therefore remain untouched.
        (reduce (lambda (a cc)
          (let* ((rows-here (map fst
                             (filter (lambda (cp) (= (snd cp) cc)) cpositions))))
            (if (< (length rows-here) 2) a
              (let* ((rmin (min-list rows-here))
                     (rmax (max-list rows-here)))
                (reduce (lambda (a2 cr)
                  (let* ((pr (* 3 cr)) (pc (* 3 cc)))
                    (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell a2 pr pc mc)
                      pr (+ pc 1) mc) (+ pr 1) pc mc) (+ pr 1) (+ pc 1) mc)))
                  a (range rmin (+ rmax 1)))))))
          acc2 ccol-set)))
      g mcolors))))
